title.en: Reading concrete pump rubber spring φ150 with the section names of Precast concrete
title.zh: 用来源页《预制混凝土》的章节名来读concrete pump rubber spring φ150

description.en: Precast concrete provides the section names for concrete pump rubber spring φ150. The φ150 spring is one piece-row on the Xingtai rubber-spring page. Printed materials for this row: rubber. It is a damping spring for a concrete-pump piston, not the piston itself.
description.zh: 《预制混凝土》为concrete pump rubber spring φ150提供章节名。φ150 弹簧是邢台橡胶弹簧页上的一行，按个。这一行印出的材料：橡胶。它是混凝土泵活塞用的缓冲弹簧，不是活塞本身。

h1.en: concrete pump rubber spring φ150 without figures beyond the row, under Precast concrete
h1.zh: concrete pump rubber spring φ150不超出已印行，标题来自《预制混凝土》

directAnswer.en: concrete pump rubber spring φ150 is restated below in Hebei Pinjin Machinery’s own catalogue words. The section order is the order of Precast concrete, and that page is not a second nameplate. The φ150 spring is one piece-row on the Xingtai rubber-spring page. Printed materials for this row: rubber. It is a damping spring for a concrete-pump piston, not the piston itself.
directAnswer.zh: concrete pump rubber spring φ150下面用河北品锦机械目录里已经有的说法重述。章节次序来自《预制混凝土》，那一页不是第二块铭牌。 φ150 弹簧是邢台橡胶弹簧页上的一行，按个。这一行印出的材料：橡胶。它是混凝土泵活塞用的缓冲弹簧，不是活塞本身。

body.en: Read “Overview” as the source author’s section, not as a Pinjin test result. The sentence that follows is the printed fragment. The page lists φ150, φ180, φ200, φ230, φ235 and φ260. Rubber rows are φ150, φ180, φ200, φ230 and φ260. Polyurethane rows are φ200, φ230, φ235 and φ260. This φ150 row is rubber. Unit: piece. Hardness and service life are missing. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A split or integral piston at φ150, where that size exists, is a different product page and a different unit. φ235 is on the spring page only. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 把“概述”读成来源作者的分节，不要读成品锦的试验结果。后面跟的是已印片段。 页面列出 φ150、φ180、φ200、φ230、φ235、φ260。橡胶行是 φ150、φ180、φ200、φ230、φ260。聚氨酯行是 φ200、φ230、φ235、φ260。φ150 这一行是橡胶。单位：个。硬度和寿命缺失。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 若分体或整体活塞也有 φ150，那是另一张产品页，单位也不同。φ235 只在弹簧页上。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: “History” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write rubber spring or polyurethane spring, φ150, and the quantity in pieces, matching the material row above. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: “历史”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 按上面的材料行写橡胶弹簧或聚氨酯弹簧、φ150 和个数。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: Read “Reinforcement” as the source author’s section, not as a Pinjin test result. The sentence that follows is the printed fragment. The φ150 spring is one piece-row on the Xingtai rubber-spring page. Printed materials for this row: rubber. It is a damping spring for a concrete-pump piston, not the piston itself. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 把“增强”读成来源作者的分节，不要读成品锦的试验结果。后面跟的是已印片段。 φ150 弹簧是邢台橡胶弹簧页上的一行，按个。这一行印出的材料：橡胶。它是混凝土泵活塞用的缓冲弹簧，不是活塞本身。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Products”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. The heading stops there.
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“来源章节：Products”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 标题到此为止。

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “Limitations”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 来源页在“局限”处分开叙述。这一节沿用该标题，底下只重复邢台已经印出的说法。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: “Structures” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “来源章节：Structures”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: “Regulations” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 橡胶弹簧 page plus this size and the quantity. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Precast_concrete
body.zh: “法规”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明橡胶弹簧这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Precast_concrete
